title: PR #236: docs(architecture): clarify seven building-block boundaries
content:
State: open
Merged: False

## Summary

Clarifies the seven-building-block architecture in the existing canonical layer-architecture document, without introducing a parallel architecture SSOT.

### Added
- Responsibility and authority boundaries for ATCLang, ShivaCore, Aurora AI, A-TownChain, ATC-VM, GlobusOS and Genesis Engine.
- A conceptual architecture flow that separates the developer/execution domain, system platform and independent domain platforms.
- Explicit relationship rules for ATCLang ↔ ATC-VM, ShivaCore → GlobusOS, A-TownChain ↔ ATC-VM, and optional Aurora AI / Genesis Engine integrations.
- Fail-closed evidence language: undocumented or unverified integrations remain RESIDUAL, UNRESOLVED or BLOCKED.

### Governance
- Preserves Standalone First · Native Implementation · Ecosystem Second.
- Preserves component repositories as implementation SSOTs.
- Does not claim full integration, production readiness, compiler/VM compatibility, or E2E verification.
- Does not silently migrate the draft L0–L10 / X1–X8 registry to the separately documented L0–L9 / X0–X36 target model.

### Validation status
Documentation-only change. No implementation or verification status is promoted by this PR. Required CI must be inspected on the exact PR head before acceptance.
